facts.text: I need to compress a LiFePo4 battery cell to meet manufacture specifications.
The LiFePo4 battery cell is in the shape of a rectangular cube.
The LiFePo4 battery cell dimensions are 205 mm height, 174 mm width, and 72 mm thickness.
I want to compress the cell on both sides of its largest face.
The cell needs to experience 300 kgf of fixturing.
The cell will be sandwiched between two steel compression plates.
At each corner of the steel plate there will be a grade 5 steel 1/4 threaded rod.
The rods run straight through the cell and connect to the opposite steel compression plate on the opposite side.
The steel plate measures 205 mm x 174 mm.
I asked whether the compression factor accounts for compression being applied to two faces.
I asked how tight the threaded rods must be to achieve the required compression, measured in ft/lbs.

keyphrases: 205 mm height 174 mm width 72 mm thick
compress on both sides of largest face
